description:
Police-recorded offences in Queensland by council area, per year for 2016-2025, by offence type.

Coverage: Queensland: 77 council areas; calendar years 2016-2025. Current to 2025-12-31. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/recorded-crime-qld`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_offences, advertising_prostitution, armed_robbery, arson, attempted_murder, bomb_possess_and_or_use_of, breach_domestic_violence_protection_order, coercive_control, common_assault, conspiracy_to_murder, dangerous_operation_of_a_vehicle, disobey_move_on_direction, disqualified_driving, drink_driving, driving_causing_death, extortion, fare_evasion, found_in_places_used_for_purpose_of_prostitution_offences, fraud_by_cheque, fraud_by_computer, fraud_by_credit_card, gaming_racing_and_betting_offences, grievous_assault, have_interest_in_premises_used_for_prostitution_offences, homicide_murder, identity_fraud, interfere_with_mechanism_of_motor_vehicle, kidnapping_and_abduction_etc, knowingly_participate_in_provision_prostitution_offences, life_endangering_acts, liquor_excl_drunkenness, manslaughter_excl_by_driving, manslaughter_unlawful_striking_causing_death, miscellaneous_offences, other_drug_offences, other_fraud, other_handling_stolen_goods, other_property_damage, other_prostitution_offences, other_sexual_offences, other_stealing, permit_minor_to_be_at_a_place_used_for_prostitution_offences, possess_and_or_use_other_weapons_restricted_items, possess_drugs, possess_etc_tainted_property, possess_property_suspected_stolen, procuring_prostitution, produce_drugs, public_nuisance, public_soliciting, rape_and_attempted_rape, receiving_stolen_property, resist_incite_hinder_obstruct_police, sell_supply_drugs, serious_assault, serious_assault_other, shop_stealing, stalking, stealing_from_dwellings, stock_related_offences, trafficking_drugs, trespassing_and_vagrancy, unarmed_robbery, unlawful_entry_with_intent_dwelling, unlawful_entry_with_intent_other, unlawful_entry_with_intent_shop, unlawful_possess_concealable_firearm, unlawful_possess_firearm_other, unlawful_use_of_motor_vehicle, vehicles_steal_from_enter_with_intent, weapons_act_offences_other. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
